page.overview:
Who is Chutney Chocolatecane?

→ Not to be confused with the Campaign Three gnome Chetney Pock O'Pea.

is a Christmas elf Rogue played by Travis Willingham for .

Chutney started off seeming like a loyal elf to Santa, but as soon as Saint Nick got kidnapped by the Hallow King, he changed his tune, putting forth the idea of leaving Santa to die and taking over the North Pole. He was quite frustrated by the tasks Santa was giving him, complaining about nobody wanting a wooden Voltron, that he can't wire a Gameboy, and how the hair didn't move on a troll doll he made.

Chutney is one of the oldest elves working for Saint Nick. His expertise is in wooden toys, but times (and children) have changed and he has been under pressure to produce less traditional playthings. For a long time, he tolerated this burden but was secretly nursing a growing grudge against Santa.
